New Zealand.name: New Zealand
New Zealand.shortDescription: A breathtaking wonderland of snow-capped Southern Alps, ancient fjords, geothermal geysers, and pristine sub-antarctic coastlines.
New Zealand.description: New Zealand is a pure paradise for travellers seeking sublime alpine panoramas, rich Maori indigenous heritage, world-class Pinot Noir vineyards, and thrilling adventure. From Auckland's twin harbours to the subterranean glow of Waitomo Caves, the alpine serenity of Queenstown, and the majestic waterfalls tumbling down Milford Sound, every corner delivers cinematic beauty.
New Zealand.topAttractions: Milford Sound, Waitomo Caves, Hobbiton Movie Set, Franz Josef Glacier, Lake Tekapo
highlights: Cruise through the dramatic misty cliffs of Milford Sound fjord
Glide on underground rivers under twinkling bioluminescent glowworms

Experience authentic Te Puia geothermal geysers and Maori Hangi feasts
Indulge in Pinot Noir tasting among the dramatic peaks of Central Otago

packages.title: Natural Wonders of New Zealand – 10 Nights / 11 Days
packages.destinations: Auckland • Rotorua • Queenstown • Milford Sound • Franz Josef • Christchurch
features: Milford Sound Nature Cruise with Lunch
packages.overview: Experience the awe-inspiring landscapes of Middle-earth on this signature 11-day journey across New Zealand's North and South Islands. From the subterranean glow of Waitomo Caves and geothermal wonders of Rotorua to the dramatic fjords of Milford Sound and alpine peaks of Queenstown, this trip delivers pure luxury and adventure.
highlights: Guided boat tour through the illuminated Waitomo Glowworm Caves
Full-length scenic fjord cruise in world-famous Milford Sound
Historic TranzAlpine train ride through the Southern Alps
Evening Maori cultural performance and traditional Hangi feast
Panoramic Skyline Gondola ride overlooking Lake Wakatipu
Glacier viewing and alpine walks at Franz Josef

travelTips: Best Time to Visit: October to April offers pleasant warm weather ideal for outdoor sightseeing and alpine adventures.

Driving & Safety: In NZ, traffic moves on the left. Emergency number is 111.

procedure: Complete the online application through the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs portal
Schedule a mandatory biometric appointment at the nearest VFS Global centre
Attend the appointment in person for biometric fingerprints, photograph, and document submission
Track your application online and collect your passport with Schengen visa vignette sticker
restrictions: Apply at least 4 to 6 weeks before planned departure date due to high appointment demand
Switzerland must be your main destination (longest stay duration) or the first point of entry into the Schengen zone
visaRecords.notes: A Schengen visa issued by Switzerland allows unrestricted travel throughout all 29 member countries of the Schengen Area for the duration of the visa.

visaRecords.visaCategory: Visa Exemption Scheme for Indian Citizens
documents: Passport with at least 6 months validity from entry date and 2 blank pages
Confirmed return or onward flight ticket departing Thailand within 60 days
Proof of confirmed accommodation (hotel vouchers or host invitation)
Proof of adequate funds (minimum 10,000 THB per person or 20,000 THB per family in cash or card equivalent)
procedure: Arrive at any international airport in Thailand (e.g. Suvarnabhumi BKK, Don Mueang DMK, Phuket HKT)
Proceed directly to the standard passport control immigration counters
Present passport and boarding pass to receive the 60-day visa exemption entry stamp
Clear customs and begin your holiday
restrictions: Land border entries under visa exemption are limited to a maximum of 2 times per calendar year
Visa exemption is solely for tourism purposes and cannot be converted into employment
visaRecords.notes: The Royal Thai Government has granted bilateral visa-free access to Indian passport holders for stays up to 60 days, extendable for an additional 30 days at local Thai immigration offices.

visaRecords.visaCategory: Singapore Entry Visa (Sub-class via Authorized Agents)
visaRecords.fees: SGD 30 + Authorized agent processing fee (approx. ₹2,800 total)
documents: Original Indian passport with at least 6 months validity
Completed and signed Form 14A
Two recent color photographs (35mm x 45mm, matte finish, semi-glossy, 80% face view, plain white background)
Confirmed onward or return flight itinerary
Covering letter from the applicant stating travel purpose and dates
Mandatory SG Arrival Card (SGAC) with electronic health declaration completed online within 3 days prior to arrival
procedure: Submit Form 14A and supporting documents to an authorized Singapore visa agent (such as MHM Travels)
Agent logs into the Singapore Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) SAVE system
ICA processes and approves the electronic visa
